hero.speak: Smash burger bowl. A burger and fries, rebuilt as a high-protein bowl, in about thirty minutes.
hero.caption: A burger and fries, rebuilt as a high-protein bowl. One serving, about 30 minutes.

apart.speak: Here is what goes in it.
apart.caption: Here is what goes in it.

potatoes.speak: Start with the potatoes. Poke each one a few times with a fork.
potatoes.caption: Poke 3 small potatoes (8 oz) a few times with a fork.

potatoes.speak: Microwave them on high for five to six minutes, until a fork slides in.
potatoes.caption: Microwave on high for 5 to 6 min, until a fork slides in easily.

potatoes.speak: Let them cool for five minutes, so the outsides dry.
potatoes.caption: Let them cool on a cutting board for 5 min so the outsides dry.

potatoes.speak: Press each one flat with a cup, and brush with oil.
potatoes.caption: Press each one 1/2 inch thick with the bottom of a cup. Brush with oil.

potatoes.speak: Air-fry at four hundred degrees for twelve to fifteen minutes, until deep golden.
potatoes.caption: Air-fry at 400°F for 12 to 15 min (or roast at 425°F for 18 to 20), flipping once.

sauce.speak: While they cook, make the sauce.
sauce.caption: While they cook, make the special sauce.

sauce.speak: A teaspoon each of mayo, ketchup, and mustard.
sauce.caption: 1 tsp each of mayo, ketchup, and yellow mustard

sauce.speak: A tablespoon of chopped pickles, and a teaspoon of the juice.
sauce.caption: 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles, plus 1 tsp pickle juice

sauce.speak: A pinch of garlic powder and smoked paprika.
sauce.caption: A pinch each of garlic powder and smoked paprika
Stir until pink. Chill for at least 10 minutes.

mushrooms.speak: Put the mushrooms and onions in a hot, dry pan, and leave them for two minutes.
mushrooms.caption: Mushrooms and sliced onion in a dry pan on medium-high. Hands off for 2 min.

mushrooms.speak: Then add a little oil, stir until browned, and finish with Worcestershire.
mushrooms.caption: Add 1/2 tsp oil and stir 3 to 4 min until browned. Worcestershire for the last 30 seconds.

patties.speak: Now the patties. Get the pan smoking hot, and add a little oil.
patties.caption: Heat the pan on high for 3 min, until it just smokes. Add 1/2 tsp oil.

patties.speak: Put in the beef, cover it with parchment, and press it flat.
patties.caption: Add the 2 beef balls. Parchment on top, and press flat within 10 seconds.

patties.speak: Leave it alone for two minutes, so a crust forms.
patties.caption: Salt and pepper, then hands off for 2 min while a dark crust forms.

patties.speak: Flip, add the cheese, and cover until it melts.
patties.caption: Flip, add half a slice of cheese to each, and cover for 20 to 30 seconds.

build.speak: Build the bowl in two halves.
build.caption: Build the bowl in two halves.

build.speak: Romaine, tomato, onion, and pickles on one side.
build.caption: The cold side: romaine, tomato, onion, and pickles.

build.speak: Potatoes, patties, and mushrooms on the other.
build.caption: The hot side: potatoes, patties, and mushrooms.

finish.speak: Drizzle on the sauce, and serve the smoky beans on the side.
finish.caption: Drizzle on the sauce. Smoky pinto beans go on the side.

finish.speak: About nine hundred calories and fifty-seven grams of protein. The full recipe is at L M Dav dot com.
finish.caption: About 900 calories and 57 g protein. The full recipe is at lmdav.com/recipes.
